text:
harper (sales): Lee on the demo call. Calls to /v1/generate intermittently return 403 with "key bound to different org". Need quick triage, customer waiting.

nina (sales-eng): Hi Lee — could you paste the curl and full error body? 403 usually means header/org mismatch or key binding.

lee (customer): Curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_DEMO_X9" -H "X-Org-Id: org-live-77" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"summarize"}'
```
Error: {"error":"access_denied","detail":"key bound to org-internal-02"}

tyler (platform): auth-bot: check token SK_DEMO_X9 binding please.

auth-bot: token-inspect: SK_DEMO_X9 -> bound_org: org-internal-02, scopes: [generate, chat], created_by: sales-sandbox

nina (sales-eng): Looks like the token is bound to org-internal-02. If you include X-Org-Id org-live-77 we'll get that 403. Two fixes: remove header to let key binding decide, or issue a key for org-live-77.

lee (customer): The dashboard showed org-live-77. Could that be a different account? We're on the trial invite link for live.

harper (sales): Possible they accepted a join link that created a separate tenant. Lee, quick check: run GET /v1/account/keys with the same token to see bound_org.

lee (customer): Running... got bound_org: org-internal-02. If I remove X-Org-Id now, request works.

nina (sales-eng): Great. For the demo, drop the X-Org-Id. For production, we should issue a key explicitly for org-live-77. Tyler, can we create a short-lived key bound to org-live-77 and add embeddings scope if requested?

tyler (platform): Yes. Creating demo key now. auth-bot: issue temp key bound to org-live-77 expires 3600s.

auth-bot: issued: EK_TEMP_77 scope: generate bound_org: org-live-77 expires_in: 3600

lee (customer): EK_TEMP_77 works, demo proceeds :tada:

harper (sales): Follow-ups: 1) nina to ask customer if they want a permanent key for org-live-77, 2) harper to send pricing/billing note (contracts-bot for trial terms), 3) nina to own security questionnaire handoff.

contracts-bot: FYI: trial keys billed to sales sandbox unless fielded to contracted org. Contact contracts@redwood.ai for enterprise discounts.

nina (sales-eng): Noted. Also filing a tiny UX request: when we return access_denied we should include bound_org in the error payload to reduce back-and-forth. I'll open an internal ticket.

lee (customer): Appreciate the fast fix. Will DM security form.

harper (sales): Closing thread, will update ticket with artifacts. Thanks team!
